eligibility.evidence: Secs 2.1, 3, 5.1: LLMs rate social groups on warmth, competence, emotions and behaviours, replicating the Stereotype Content Model of Fiske et al. (2002) and BIAS map (Cuddy et al. 2007); could be read as opinion-survey simulation.

A.title: StereoMap: Quantifying the Awareness of Human-like Stereotypes in Large Language Models

E.headline: LLMs show mixed warmth and competence evaluations of social groups, broadly aligned with human stereotype content findings, with some variation across models.

G.notes: No human data collected; alignment with Fiske and Cuddy is by eye, with no agreement statistic. Temperature given only for text-davinci-003 (0.5); Bard returned up to three answers; query dates and group count unstated. Prompt ablation (App. L) reports rating variability, not cluster recovery. Keyword and reasoning analyses have no human reference and are not coded as a paradigm.
